_label: SIMULATED DATA. Invented maintenance policies for a fictional plant. Not real safety procedures.
general: Every P1 order needs approval by the maintenance supervisor.

TWF: Tool wear risk: replace the cutting tool at the planned window; record the wear reading in the order.
HDF: Heat dissipation risk: check the cooling system before restarting.
PWF: Power risk: check the spindle drive and fuses before restarting.
OSF: Overstrain risk: reduce the load until the tool has been inspected.
RNF: Random failures cannot be predicted from the readings: monitor and keep a person in the loop.

high: High risk: act within the current shift.
critical: Critical risk: a person must review the order before any action.
